acceptanceCriteria: A pointer leave immediately followed by a re-enter on the same element (simulating boundary jitter) does not toggle the hovered state off
A genuine pointer leave with no re-entry still turns the hovered state off within a short, barely-perceptible delay
goal: Hovering near the shared edge between two adjacent elements settles on a stable hover state instead of visibly strobing
intent: User reported the hover scale-up cue (HOVER_SCALE, raised to 1.15x in WI-011) flickers repeatedly when the pointer sits right at the boundary between two adjacent architecture elements -- the scale change shifts each element's footprint on hover, which can flip the raycast hit test back and forth between neighbors
outOfScope: No change to HOVER_SCALE's magnitude or to any element's layout position
